This name is a reminder of our connection to the Hindu culture and faith.

historical_references.context: Sharvanjee was a prominent figure in Jainism during the medieval period in India. He is known for his contributions to Jain philosophy and is considered an influential thinker in the tradition.

historical_references.reference: Sharvanjee is also known for his role in the development of the Digambara sect of Jainism. He is believed to have established the major Digambara monastery at Mount Shatrunjaya in Gujarat.
